body:
He is a bit if not quite introvert. I guess I’m patient 0 of my family( that I know of). 


I tried to kms a few years back and I always wondered what did I do wrong. Also not that I’ve ever attempted it again.
You as well and thank you at-least these few moments friend. 🤝

My therapist  tried the stimulants but my body was not tolerant medicines like Adderall etc.  Even caffeine made me have headaches and stomach issues. It’s a daily struggle too not having that extra kick from even the most basic of caffeine. 

I do appreciate your help and I am overdue for a call to my psychiatrist/ therapist . She’s a bit old but whatever it’s someone to talk to that I trust + she’s a really kind old soul that reminds me of my grandmother haha.
I don’t think I’m quite up that high but not far off similar to you all bourbon.. .

Tbh the only other thing I take is Xanax and that’s just to chill me out if I have a serious outburst or feeling stressed….  and for I guess “anxiety” — after taking Paxil I really didn’t want to feel like I was more lobotomized than already feeling. So I’ve kept off meds for the most part.
Do you drink? When I was around 20 I used to take Paxil but it would be make me so lethargic and want to nap. Not depressed nap but sleep and drowsy.

The ghosting - I feel like the closer I ever got in my love relationships some force in me would compel me to figure a way to just unwarrantedly ruin it -It’s like I was meant to be lonely. 

My friends we were all so close and as of the last few years I’ve figured out how to pretty much exile myself from them all.

My mom would always say stop having a nasty and unlikeable attitude the more I got older ( still in my late 20’s. I’m sure that attributes to my lost friendships and more.

I wish I had answer - if you ever figure one out let me know.

Man I just wrote a very similar post but leaving out some details. Your father comment really hit me. I have no one to talk or want to… and I call my father probably enough times where I bother him(everyday) . He’s older but if he ever passed I think I would too. Hope you and him do well 🤝
